decisions: Section 2.2 supports disturbed air-dried soil passed through a 2-mm sieve, represented as fine_earth.
Particle fractions retain USDA diameter boundaries and the reported Bouyoucos hydrometer method with 5-percent sodium hexametaphosphate dispersant.

Sections 2.3-2.4 identify Walkley-Black organic carbon and the factor 1.724 used to obtain organic matter. The required organic-matter input retains this operational definition; no generic humus or carbon substitution is authorized.
Water outputs are explicitly mass of water per mass of dry soil. Public outputs use mass_fraction; source regression percentages are divided by 100 by the existing formulas.
Field capacity and wilting point retain magnitude conditions of 33 and 1500 kPa, respectively, and the disturbed-ring retention method.
Capillary saturation is reported without an exact controlled suction. Its descriptor has no fixed-pressure condition; it cannot be scored as an assumed zero-kPa output.
The new organic_matter_content quantity is distinct from organic_carbon_content; a unit conversion cannot interchange them.
No coefficients, formulas, class values or function statuses are changed.
limitations: Reported Moroccan agricultural topsoils at 0-20 cm are source calibration scope, not a validated transfer domain for meta_v3.3.
A deterministic carbon-to-organic-matter calculation still requires verified transformation lineage and does not automatically enter the observed-only benchmark.
Raw predictors, observation preparation and exact target pressures require separate dataset review.
The paper reports 331 samples, while its listed regional counts sum to 341; no raw sample crosswalk is supplied. No sample-count confidence claim is inferred.
Unpublished fitted trees and ensembles remain blocked under the existing specification.
